notable_absence.finding: This page never cross-references sdk:error-handling or the extraction-layer sdk:retry-strategy concept, despite framing tracing explicitly as key to 'debugging and troubleshooting' - a natural link between 'why did this request fail' and 'how long did this request take' is absent in both directions.

cross_component_finding: This page's Request Tracing JSON example (per-request encode_duration_us/dispatch_duration_us/server_duration_us breakdown) and best-practices.md's 'Threshold Logging' section (a flat 'Threshold Log: {...,"top":[...]}' line reporting the slowest operations) describe overlapping observability surfaces from two different concept-docs pages. I did not merge them speculatively here - see best-practices.json's own extraction for the resolution, which reuses sdk:request-tracer for the Threshold Logging section rather than minting a duplicate concept, once that page's wording confirmed it is the same default tracer.
cross_product_finding: sdk:app-telemetry's TIP box on this page ('SDK is telemetry is also sent to the Server — available from 8.0, and in new Capella Operational clusters — for ingestion with other Prometheus metrics') restates - with slightly different wording and an apparent typo ('SDK is telemetry') - the same fact already captured with cleaner wording ('SDK telemetry is also sent to the Server') on howtos/collecting-information-and-logging.json. Two Java SDK concept/howto pages carry near-duplicate copies of what looks like shared boilerplate about the same Server-8.0 Prometheus-ingestion bridge, with minor textual drift between them.
